findings.why: Replacing zinc-nickel with zinc flake on HS-410 (PRG-X, Aurelia) is a coating change. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual replaces revision 3. Under rev 4 a coating change needs written Aurelia approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipment, plus 90 days' notice. The old rev 3 rule (notification only, within the same specification family) no longer applies. DEV-121 only covers the zinc-nickel layer thickness and does not cover a change of coating.
